question: Happy Birthday, Professor Greycat! Thanks for all your hard work. Anastasia seems to be on good terms with the knight Julius, but do they normally go drinking together?
answer: Indeed, I'd guess that happens quite a bit. Rather than an invitation from Julius, Anastasia inviting seems like it would be more common. She's the type that relaxes properly after she's finished work, but Julius isn't very good at that so he needs to let off steam. As well, Julius has a better-filled wine cellar.
